_provenance.scope: Statutory programme-of-study statements only (the 'Pupils should be taught' lists), verbatim. Non-statutory notes and guidance, aims, purpose of study and appendices are not included.

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to use a range of materials creatively to design and make products

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to use drawing, painting and sculpture to develop and share their ideas, experiences and imagination

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to develop a wide range of art and design techniques in using colour, pattern, texture, line, shape, form and space

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: about the work of a range of artists, craft makers and designers, describing the differences and similarities between different practices and disciplines, and making links to their own work

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to create sketch books to record their observations and use them to review and revisit ideas

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to improve their mastery of art and design techniques, including drawing, painting and sculpture with a range of materials [for example, pencil, charcoal, paint, clay]

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: about great artists, architects and designers in history

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to use a range of techniques to record their observations in sketchbooks, journals and other media as a basis for exploring their ideas

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to use a range of techniques and media, including painting

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to increase their proficiency in the handling of different materials

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: to analyse and evaluate their own work, and that of others, in order to strengthen the visual impact or applications of their work

statements.subject: art and design
statements.text: about the history of art, craft, design and architecture, including periods, styles and major movements from ancient times up to the present day
